passage.label: Say Muhammad revealed me group jinn listened said indeed heard amazing Quran guides right course believed never associate Lord anyone; exalted nobleness Lord not taken wife son; foolish one saying Allah excessive transgression; thought mankind jinn never speak Allah lie; men mankind sought refuge men jinn increased burden; thought as you thought Allah never send anyone messenger; sought reach heaven found filled powerful guards burning flames; used sit therein positions hearing whoever listens now find burning flame lying wait; do not know whether evil intended earth or Lord intends right course; among us righteous among us not so divided ways; become certain never cause failure Allah upon earth nor escape Him flight; heard guidance believed whoever believes Lord not fear deprivation burden; among us Muslims among us unjust whoever become Muslim sought out right course; unjust will be Hell firewood

arabicExcerpts.text: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا
يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا
وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا
وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطٗا
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا
وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا
وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا
وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا
وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا
وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدٗا
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا
وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا

mainSubject.label: Revelation that a group of jinn listened to an amazing Quran guiding to the right course, believed in it and resolved never to associate partners with their Lord; they affirm His exalted nobleness without wife or son, repudiating their own foolish one's excessive transgression and acknowledging that both mankind and jinn had spoken lies about Allah; human men seeking refuge in jinn only increased their burden, and both species had wrongly assumed Allah would never send a messenger; their attempt to eavesdrop on heaven now met with powerful guards and burning flames where listening posts once stood; uncertainty whether evil or guidance is intended for earth's inhabitants; internal division acknowledged — righteous and otherwise, Muslims and unjust — with certainty that neither escape nor causing failure against Allah is possible; belief in the guidance removing fear of deprivation or burden, while the unjust are destined as Hell's firewood

It guides to the right course and they believed, resolving never to associate partners with their Lord

Human men seeking refuge in jinn only increased their burden
Both species had wrongly assumed Allah would never send a messenger
Their attempt to reach heaven found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames
Former listening posts now replaced by ambush-flames for any eavesdropper
Uncertainty whether evil or a right course is intended for those on earth
Internal division acknowledged: righteous and otherwise among them
Certainty reached that neither escape nor causing failure against Allah is possible
Belief in the guidance removing fear of deprivation or burden
Muslims and unjust among them distinguished; becoming Muslim means seeking the right course
The unjust destined as firewood for Hell

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the unjust-as-firewood verdict (15) before the istiqamah-provision and masjid-purity block opens (16); P2 ends with the eternal-Hellfire verdict for disobedience (23) before the eschatological-timing and unseen-knowledge block begins (24); P3 covers the promise-visibility, timing-ignorance and guarded-unseen disclosure (24-28).
